personality_one_liner: A highly secure, cinematic digital vault that turns tedious tax data into a premium, frictionless Apple Wallet-style identity card.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic spacing. Use lg and xl for breathing room around the main card. No cramped elements.

do's: Use heavy blur (expo-blur) over translucent surfaceSecondary for sticky headers, bottom sheets, and the main card reflection
Ensure text on glass is fully readable by adding a tinted underlay (≥75% opacity)
dont's: Do not apply glass to form fields or body text regions
Do not use cheap glossy gradients, rely on blur over texture

screens.name: Welcome & Auth
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's premium vibe and handle login/registration seamlessly.
screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract premium dark metal image background with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surface at bottom). Massive display serif typography. Bottom-anchored glass card for Auth form (Email/Pass + CTA).

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Communicate the core value: 'Mai più comunicare a voce i tuoi dati fiscali.'
screens.layout: Carousel with cinematic imagery and serif headlines. Sticky bottom CTA 'Start' over a frosted glass bar.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: The core minimalist hub showcasing the digital Fiscal Identity Card.

states.empty: Ghost card outlining where the identity card will be, prompting setup

screens.layout: Minimalist dark canvas. Top greeting. The absolute hero is a large Apple Wallet-styled 'Fiscal Identity Card' centered on screen. The card uses a premium metal texture background, glassmorphism overlays for text legibility, and displays key data cleanly. Below the card: a row of glass action buttons (Share, Scan, Edit).

screens.name: FiscalProfileForm
screens.purpose: Collect tax and identity data without feeling like a bureaucratic form.

states.loading: Subtle loading state on save CTA

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable list of inputs grouped into sections (Anagrafica, Dati Fiscali). Floating labels. Sticky glass bottom bar with 'Save' CTA.

screens.name: ShareScreen
screens.purpose: Generate and display the secure QR code for sharing data.
screens.layout: Presented as a modal bottom sheet or full screen overlay. The QR code must be on a high-contrast white card (`surfaceInverse`) to ensure scanability by all cameras. Below it, clear share actions (Copy Link, Share via OS).

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: In-app QR scanner for operators to quickly capture fiscal data.
screens.layout: Full-screen camera viewfinder. A high-contrast central reticle/frame. Segmented control at the bottom to switch between 'Scan' and 'My Card'.

screens.name: PublicSharePage
screens.purpose: Clean read-only view of the shared fiscal data (accessed via QR).
screens.layout: Clean, structured list of data rows (Label + Value). 'Conferma acquisizione dati' sticky primary CTA.

screens.name: ShareHistory
screens.purpose: Track when and with whom data was shared.
screens.layout: Simple chronological list of sharing events. Each row has a glass background on press.

welcome_background.alt: Abstract black and emerald green waves

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 6 Glass / Luxe DARK personality. Do not use random gray shades; stick to the defined deep obsidian and emerald palette.

Implement the 'Fiscal Identity Card' using the provided 'card_background' image wrapped in `expo-image`, overlaid with a vertical linear gradient (transparent to dark) and glassmorphism elements to ensure text remains highly legible.
Avoid making the app look like a typical boring tax utility; it must feel like a premium fintech product (e.g., Apple Card or Revolut Metal). Use Fraunces for display headings.
QR codes must be placed on a surfaceInverse (white) background regardless of dark mode, as cameras struggle to scan inverted QR codes.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple colors anywhere in the app. Emerald green is our primary brand accent.
For the scanner screen, use `expo-camera` or `react-native-vision-camera` taking up the full screen with absolute positioned UI (reticle, bottom controls) layered on top.
Ensure all interactive elements have subtle scale animations on press (haptics + 0.98 scale down).
Use a gradient scrim (top to bottom fade) over background images to guarantee contrast for text overlay.
